name: TejashwiniSaravanan/Absenteeism-At-Work-PowerBI-ML
description: End-to-end HR analytics project predicting employee absenteeism with 84% Random Forest accuracy. Includes Python EDA identifying Winter and March as peak risk periods, BMI and transportation expense as top predictors, and a four-page interactive Power BI dashboard covering trends, health lifestyle analysis, workplace factors, and KPI summary.

name: TejashwiniSaravanan/Credit-Risk-Prediction-Dash-Dashboard

name: TejashwiniSaravanan/Healthcare-Analytics-PySpark-ML-GCP-Strategy
description: Two-part project combining a PySpark MLlib pipeline (83.12% accuracy) with a GCP cloud architecture proposal for real-time patient monitoring. Covers feature engineering, Random Forest classification, and HIPAA-compliant healthcare infrastructure using BigQuery, Vertex AI, and Cloud Healthcare API.

name: TejashwiniSaravanan/BeatBlast-RealTime-Streaming-Pipeline

name: TejashwiniSaravanan/Spotify-Big-Data-Analysis-Spark
description: Scalable PySpark pipeline analyzing 600k+ Spotify tracks (1921-2020). Covers schema enforcement, temporal trend analysis, multi-criteria filtering, and optimized Parquet storage on Google Colab.

name: TejashwiniSaravanan/global-affordability-dashboard-tableau-ml
description: End-to-end ML and Tableau project analyzing urban affordability across 3,700+ cities and 195+ countries. Engineers a custom Affordability Score, achieves R² of 0.975 with Random Forest, and segments cities into economic profiles using K-Means clustering. Identifies 127 Crisis Zone countries where living costs exceed local earnings.
